Hannah (Docs): Heads-up  linkcheck failed on the site publish. Example error points to a heading with inline code + parentheses. CI snippet:

```
WARN Broken anchor: /docs/sdk#`Client.get_config()` -> not found
```

Hannah (Docs): The heading in question is exactly:

```markdown
### `Client.get_config()` helper
```

Omar (DevEx): This is the slugifier mismatch we've seen before after migrating from MkDocs. Different slug rules -> anchors diverge. Quick unblock: add an explicit id to the heading: `### `Client.get_config()` helper {#client-get-config}` and update links to that id.

Victor (Infra): For a systemic fix we should normalize slug behavior at build-time. Two options: pin the slug library version used by Docusaurus, or add a rehype-slug with a custom slugify that strips punctuation and collapses non-alphanum to hyphens.

Hannah (Docs): I can open a tiny content PR now to add ids to the three pages CI flagged so the release isn't blocked. Will note the pattern in CONTRIBUTING.

Omar (DevEx): I'll sketch a small grep-based linter that warns when headings contain backticks or parentheses and suggests adding `{#...}` ids. Make it advisory first so we don't break existing content.

Victor (Infra): I'll prototype the rehype-slug plugin in a feature branch. If the slugify matches the old MkDocs behavior we can make linkcheck use the same slug algorithm and avoid future drift.

Hannah (Docs): PR posted: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5003  adds explicit ids for the affected headings and updates internal links. CI running.

CI-Bot: docs/linkcheck job 5003 finished  0 anchor errors remaining for patched pages; 4 unrelated external redirects remain.

Omar (DevEx): After Victor's plugin lands, we should run a site-wide pass to find headings with code and either auto-backfill ids or flag them for review. I'll add a short docs lint rule message to CONTRIBUTING in the meantime.

Victor (Infra): Agreed. Creating infra task: add rehype slug plugin, add optional migration script to backfill ids for headings with code, and update linkcheck to use canonical slug computation. Assigning to infra + devex.

Hannah (Docs): Thanks all  merging content PR now. Closing thread.
